unverified_summary: No row here carries a publisher source we could observe ourselves. Scopely posts dice links to Instagram Stories, Facebook and Discord, none of which can be reopened or archived after a drop closes, so every row rests on outlet reporting and none is publisher confirmed. Four older drops are logged by a single aggregator with no independent corroboration and are listed as awaiting editor verification for that reason. Scopely publishes no expiry window of its own, so the roughly 3 day figure comes from dated outlet evidence rather than from the publisher.

disagreements.item: How long a dice link stays claimable
disagreements.source_a: One outlet says links die within 24 hours of going live
disagreements.source_b: Another says links last around 3 days, with Instagram Story links up for 24 hours only
disagreements.confirmed: Roughly 3 days. The 25 dice drop posted on 21 August was still being listed as claimable on 24 August, which is the only dated evidence either way. Scopely states nothing.

disagreements.item: The account level needed to claim a dice link
disagreements.source_a: Several outlets say you must reach Level 15 and unlock the Album before a link will credit
disagreements.source_b: Others describe Level 15 as the sticker and Album gate rather than a gate on dice links
disagreements.confirmed: Not confirmed. No Scopely channel states a level requirement for dice links, and we could not test a low level account.

disagreements.item: How many dice a single link is worth
disagreements.source_a: One outlet says the publisher gives at least 25 free rolls a day through links
disagreements.source_b: Another says drops range from 25 to 75 and some days carry no new link at all
disagreements.confirmed: Both patterns appear in the dated archive above. Drops of 25 and 75 are recorded, and at the last check no new drop had been posted that day.

fakes.claim: Dice generators that ask for your MONOPOLY GO! username and then promise thousands of rolls
fakes.why_wrong: A genuine drop credits rolls to the account already signed in on the device you tap from. Nothing exists that grants dice from a username, and handing one over only feeds a survey or ad funnel.
fakes.origin: Ad funded generator sites and video thumbnails that rank on the same searches as the real link pages.

fakes.claim: Reward links hosted on domains other than mply.io
fakes.why_wrong: Every link Scopely distributes resolves on mply.io. Players and third party sites cannot mint one, so a reward link on any other host was not issued by the publisher.
fakes.origin: Reposts on aggregator sites and comment sections, often wrapped in a redirect chain.

fakes.claim: Four and five figure dice links, for example a 5,000 roll link
fakes.why_wrong: No dated drop on record carries a grant of that size. Recorded rewards on this page run to 75 rolls or a cosmetic shield.
fakes.origin: Fabricated screenshots circulated to drive clicks to generator pages.

changes.what: Page published with 7 recorded drops and per row posting dates
The 25 dice drop posted on 21 August moved to Expired after its window closed

next_change.pattern: Drops land most days but not every day. A 25 roll drop is the common case, a 75 roll drop tends to land at weekends and around events, and each one stays claimable for roughly 3 days. Cosmetic drops such as shield skins run for months rather than days.
